title: Cue button shows the cloud send countdown; hold-to-loop fill visible
description: Cloud runs count Sending in 3/2/1 only on the gallery card, and only when card info is on, so with it off there is no sign the Stop is still free. Cue button now carries the countdown. Separately the Cue press state painted the whole button --accent-heat, the same colour as the hold-to-loop fill, so the fill sweep was invisible.
